runtime_census.identity_boundary: Each mesh slice is bounded by the next pass-2 mesh pointer and each path by its typed 58-point record. These are runtime identities, not named visual assets or staged-overlay provenance.

threshold_controls.causal_confirmation: The branches share full RAM/register/cycle/frame/PC/SP identity before one u32 threshold write. counter8_phase_linkage.observation: Cycle-neutral traces show the six-row loop continues after the natural counter-8/master-state transition, through the approach to defeat and retirement boundary, with the final sample in scene 0. Counts are reported rather than assuming when scene geometry itself completes.

bounded_interpretation.observation: The save-owned block ramps and advances six typed 58-point paths, writes six pass-2 transforms, submits six collision candidates and compares six squared-distance thresholds. Rows 0/2/3/4 naturally clear their ramp, reverse speed and lower player health by one. Rows 1/5 remain outside their natural thresholds in this recording.
bounded_interpretation.inference: The pass-2 transform pointers join each path row to one exact, distinct bounded mesh payload. This identifies runtime model inputs but does not assign visual names or GPU ownership.
bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: For rows 1/5, increasing only the existing threshold above the measured distance produces the same ramp clear, speed reversal and one-health transition at equal endpoint frame with identical player/object positions. Row 5 ends at equal cycle with distinct PCs; row 1 ends one cycle later at the same PC. Full RAM, registers, frame, cycle, PC and SP match before each write.
bounded_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Do not infer named boulder variants, texture/GPU ownership, natural row-1/5 contact frequency, complete attack policy, retry/persistence policy, or D18/F09 completion.

bounded_open_frontier.closed_here: Six row paths, pass-2 transform/model joins, ramp/cap/threshold policy, contact reversal/reset/damage transition and post-counter-8 execution breadth.
bounded_open_frontier.still_open: Other boss attacks, full visual/geometry ownership, exact arena objective/completion request, initialization, retry, checkpoint, persistence and campaign breadth.
bounded_open_frontier.next_experiment: Use the same recording to bind another distinct attack or the exact objective/exit request; request another fixture only if neither boundary exists in the current movie.
